insight: Bootstrapped by founder Vaibhav Namburi to over $20M ARR with no outside funding after 11 earlier ventures stalled.
name: Smartlead
tagline: Cold email outreach platform with automated warmup and deliverability tooling.
description: Smartlead is a cold email platform for running outbound campaigns with unlimited connected mailboxes, automated warmup, and deliverability tooling. It unifies replies in a master inbox and adds AI agents, lead verification, and a SmartDialer for multichannel outreach.
edge: Unlimited mailboxes and auto-warmup at every tier, so cold-email scale is gated by lead volume, not per-mailbox fees.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from marketing to sales with the new Sales category.
